_comment: Message table for the S0 spine's app surface (SCR-FAT-026 device capability ledger and
command board). Applied once with: python3 tool/arb_messages.py tool/messages/n12_device_ledger.json
Arabic is the template language; every value here is written for a parent, not an engineer.
Keep the file after applying: it is the reviewable record of what was added and why.

messages.desc: S0 spine — what a device said about one of its own capabilities, in the words every capability row on the platform uses (SCR-FAT-026 — the device reported this capability as confirmed)
S0 spine — what a device said about one of its own capabilities, in the words every capability row on the platform uses (SCR-FAT-026 — the capability exists but a family step is still missing)

messages.en: Needs a permission on the phone

messages.en: The phone has not told us yet

SCR-FAT-026 — heading of the device capability ledger the phone itself reported

messages.ar: كل سطر هنا هو آخر ما بلّغ عنه الهاتف نفسه، لا ما نتمناه له.
messages.en: Every line here is the last thing the phone itself reported, not what we hope for it.
messages.desc: SCR-FAT-026 — the honesty line under the capability ledger heading

messages.en: What the phone can do, and what was ordered
messages.desc: SCR-FAT-026 — subtitle stating the source of every capability row

messages.ar: نسأل الخادم عن قدرات هذا الجهاز…
messages.en: Asking the server what this device can do…
messages.desc: SCR-FAT-026 — while the capability ledger read is in flight

messages.en: Asking the phone to check again
messages.desc: SCR-FAT-026 — label of the button that re-reads the ledger and the orders

messages.ar: لا توجد جلسة خادم — لم نعرض أي قدرة
messages.en: No server session — not one capability is shown
messages.desc: SCR-FAT-026 — this build has no server session, so the ledger is empty by choice

messages.ar: لا يملك هذا الحساب أن يرى هذا الجهاز
messages.en: This account may not see this device
messages.desc: SCR-FAT-026 — the server refused the capability read for this account

messages.ar: لم يستجب الخادم — هذه آخر حالة وصلت
messages.en: The server did not answer — this is the last state that arrived
messages.desc: SCR-FAT-026 — the ledger could not be re-read; the screen keeps the last answer and says so

messages.ar: جواب الخادم لم يُفهم — لم نعرض شيئاً
messages.en: The server's answer could not be read — nothing is shown
messages.desc: SCR-FAT-026 — a malformed ledger answer is stated as a defect, not papered over

messages.ar: لم يبلّغ هذا الجهاز عن أي قدرة بعد
messages.en: This device has not reported a single capability yet
messages.desc: SCR-FAT-026 — the ledger is genuinely empty for this device

messages.ar: هذا السجل غير مربوط بابن على الخادم
messages.en: This record is not linked to a child on the server
messages.desc: SCR-FAT-026 — the device entry carries no server child identifier, so nothing was asked

messages.en: {working} work, {waiting} still wait for your setup

messages.ar: لا يقبل الخادم أمراً بقدرة لم يؤكد الهاتف أنه يملكها
messages.en: The server takes no order for a capability the phone has not confirmed
messages.desc: SCR-FAT-026 — the spine invariant stated in the parent's words

messages.ar: لا أمر معلّق ولا سابق على هذا الجهاز
messages.en: No pending and no past order on this device
messages.desc: SCR-FAT-026 — the command ledger is empty

messages.ar: لا يملك هذا الحساب أن يرى أوامر هذا الجهاز
messages.en: This account may not see this device's orders
messages.desc: SCR-FAT-026 — the server refused the command list for this account

messages.ar: لا يقبل الجهاز أمراً الآن — إما مقطوع أو سُحب اعتماده
messages.en: The device will not take an order now — it is cut off or its trust was withdrawn
messages.desc: SCR-FAT-026 — refusal when the device itself is not eligible for commands

SCR-FAT-026 — a command the server refused. The sentence stops at the refusal on purpose: the server may or may not have explained itself, and promising that it said nothing would be the screen talking about an answer it did not read
SCR-FAT-026 — the window a command was valid for, in the device's own reported minutes

messages.en: Its window closed before it arrived
messages.desc: SCR-FAT-026 — an order whose expiry passed unexecuted
SCR-FAT-026 — command state accepted
SCR-FAT-026 — command state dispatched

SCR-FAT-026 — command state applied

SCR-FAT-026 — command state rejected

messages.ar: لا يظهر الأمر حتى يؤكد الهاتف قدرته

messages.desc: SCR-FAT-026 — why no action button is offered for a capability that is not confirmed

messages.en: Your order is on its way…
messages.desc: SCR-FAT-026 — while a command write is in flight
SCR-FAT-026 — a command receipt: what the device said it did, and when
SCR-FAT-026 — the failure reason the device or the server gave for an order
SCR-FAT-026 — when the receipt for an order arrived

messages.ar: لا يغيّر هذا الأمر وقت طفلك ولا يحجب تطبيقاً — يطلب من الهاتف أن يأخذ الإعدادات المحفوظة مرة أخرى
messages.en: This order changes no minutes and blocks no app — it asks the phone to take the stored settings again
messages.desc: SCR-FAT-026 — what the refresh command does and does not do, said before it is pressed

messages.ar: أمر الإيقاف ورفعه يُتخذان من لوحة وقت الشاشة — وهنا ترى أثره وإيصال الهاتف به
messages.en: Stopping and lifting the stop are decided on the screen-time panel — here you see the effect and the phone's receipt
messages.desc: SCR-FAT-026 — where the lock decision lives, so this screen offers one truth and not a second button

messages.en: The refresh request is recorded with the server
messages.desc: SCR-FAT-026 — after a refresh_policy order was accepted
SCR-FAT-026 — how many commands the screen drew out of how many the server returned, so a shortened list is never read as the whole history
